faq.q-reset-password: How do I reset my password?
faq.a-reset-password: To reset your password, click on the "Forgot Password" link on the login page. You'll receive an email with instructions to create a new password. If you don't receive the email within 5 minutes, check your spam folder or contact the support team.
faq.q-technical-issues: I'm experiencing technical issues with the platform. What should I do?
faq.a-technical-issues-intro: If you're experiencing technical issues, please try these troubleshooting steps:
faq.a-technical-issues-step-1: Clear your browser cache and cookies
faq.a-technical-issues-step-3: Ensure your internet connection is stable
faq.a-technical-issues-outro: If the problem persists, please submit a support ticket with details about the issue, including screenshots if possible.
faq.q-update-profile: How can I update my profile information?
faq.a-update-profile: You can update your profile information by clicking on your profile picture in the top-right corner, then selecting "Profile Settings." From there, you can edit your personal information, change your profile picture, and update your notification preferences.
faq.q-supported-browsers: What browsers are supported by the platform?
faq.a-supported-browsers-intro: Our platform supports the following browsers:
faq.a-supported-browsers-outro: For the best experience, we recommend using Google Chrome or Mozilla Firefox.

recordsUpdate.intro: Student records should be updated after each formal advising session:
recordsUpdate.forGroupSessions: Update for group advisory sessions (if notable events occurred)
recordsUpdate.followingIncident: Update following any incident or concern requiring documentation
recordsUpdate.bestPracticeBody: Focus on objective observations and specific action items. Regular updates help maintain an accurate history of student progress and ensure continuity if another advisor needs to step in.

attendanceIssues.intro: Follow this escalation process for students missing advising sessions:
attendanceIssues.firstMissBody: Send a follow-up email to reschedule
attendanceIssues.continuedBody: Request a parent/guardian meeting through administration
attendanceIssues.reminderBody: Throughout this process, maintain a supportive approach rather than punitive. There may be underlying issues causing the absences that require support.

counselorReferral.intro: Yes, you can refer a student to a counselor through this process:
counselorReferral.step1Before: Discuss your concerns with the student first
counselorReferral.formTooltip: Find this form in Resources > Forms > Student Support
counselorReferral.step3: Submit the form to the counseling department via the portal
counselorReferral.step4Before: Follow up with the counselor within
counselorReferral.urgentBody: Contact counseling department immediately by phone
counselorReferral.urgentNote: Select the "urgent" option on the referral form
